credits.title: Strawberries
credits.overview: Hasna and Meriem leave their native Morocco to work a season picking strawberries in Spain, until abuse and harassment shatter their hopes. Supported by a Spanish lawyer, they must decide whether to speak out against a powerful system.

credits.title: When the cicades fall silent
credits.overview: Sara, a 23-year-old girl, has just found out she is pregnant. It is summer in a small village in the Andalusian mountains, and she lives with her younger sister, whom she has been taking care of since they were left alone.

credits.title: Las subordinadas del género
credits.overview: Alba is a young journalist who, after talking to her friend Lidia, decides to take control of her life and start her own digital newspaper. However, an everyday decision in her routine will cause her life to end suddenly, unfairly, and senselessly.

credits.title: The Gentiles
credits.overview: Ana throws her life on the Instagram and other social networks, where she posts pictures, videos and short animations, together with witty (and lucid) texts.
